description: Return the current state of one letter: where it is, the date it goes to USPS, and the estimated delivery date. USPS does not scan plain First-Class letters at delivery, so a Standard letter ends at an expected delivery date and never reports delivery — do not tell the user a letter arrived unless the status itself says so. This creates nothing and mails nothing.
name: get_letter_status

delivered_at.description: Certified tiers only, and absent entirely for the tiers USPS does not scan.

delivery_confirmation.description: False for every tier USPS does not scan at delivery. Never claim otherwise.

description.description: One sentence for the user about where this letter is.

disclosure.description: Say this to the user whenever an expected delivery date is shown.

anyOf.description: The window (YYYY-MM-DD, New York time) USPS is expected to deliver in. USPS does not scan plain letters at delivery, so this is an estimate and never a confirmation.

livemode.description: False for sandbox letters, which are never mailed.

mail_date.description: The calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, New York time) this piece goes to USPS.

checkout_url.description: Present only while the letter is waiting for payment. Give it to the user.

total.description: An amount of money. Always read amount_cents; display is for showing the user.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

phase.description: The USPS processing phase this scan came from, 0 through 4.

status.description: Where the letter is. expected_delivery is the last state a standard or proof-of-mailing letter reaches; only certified tiers ever reach delivered.

tracking_number.description: USPS Certified Mail tracking number, present once the operator saves it.

tracking_url.description: Direct USPS tracking link. Share it with the user when available.

title: Get Letter Status
